tasks.prompt: Increase payload capacity by 30% using currently available parts. Produce a build/change plan.
tasks.expected_answer: Target 10.4 kg. Select available MTR-24-290 motors (+31.8% torque), but do not call them drop-in: create MCTRL-D1 with DRV-10A, 12 A PDB branch protection, 9.2 A firmware limit, J12 thermal validation or J14 concept, update BOM/WI-082, and rerun T-MTR-08/T-PWR-24. Account for +0.24 kg motor mass and reduced runtime.

tasks.prompt: Increase runtime to 4 hours without changing mission duty cycle.
tasks.expected_answer: Current runtime is 2.67 h. BAT-24-18 supplies the required 432 Wh but does not fit BAT-CAGE-03 and adds 1.1 kg. Plan a D1 cage/chassis extension, recheck payload/torque, update BMS capacity, BOM and power tests.

tasks.prompt: Replace J12 with the available alternate and list build changes.
tasks.expected_answer: Use NSI-MF4-LK only with a controlled D1 change: update MCB footprint/peg holes, add 2 mm chassis clearance, revise BOM and WI-114, build a QA-FIX adapter, retain the four-pin net mapping, and rerun power/retention tests.
